indirect_reasons: The comeback package (non-hero gold cap 26%→30%, Haunted Souls up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) directly softens the early lead his hook is supposed to convert.
Haunt bounty +10% pays camp clearers; Bebop has no AoE clear and no crate route, so his income gap widens against the farm heroes.
Steam Vents now grant +150% stamina regen instead of invisibility — a hooked target still gets a disengage tool, so his core problem is unchanged.
Echo Shard post-cast 0.5s→0.2s speeds his double-cast hook/bomb line, a small offset.
build_changes: Echo Shard is now a more attractive situational slot for the hook-bomb combo than it was.
heroes.one_liner: Still hooks, still can't punish a farm meta that now forgives losing teams.

indirect_reasons: Steam Vents lose invisibility (now +150% stamina regen), removing the free roam approach the KB credits with extending her gank routes.
Tunnel move speed +70%→+50% slows the district-to-district rotations her kill-based income depends on.
The comeback package (gold cap 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind) blunts the tempo snowball she converts kills into.
Haunt bounty +10% is a real offset: camps are income she can take, unlike Tough Crates her cat form can't heavy-melee.
build_changes: Lean harder on Haunt camp income between ganks now that vent invisibility is gone.
heroes.one_liner: Lost her free approach and her snowball; still dives squishies, just slower to get there.

direct_reasons: Charged Shot T2 now carries -2s charge delay, moving the charge-up talent a tier earlier for his lane poke.
Charged Shot T3 loses -3s charge delay but gains a one-bounce wall shot — a trade, not a gain.
Guided Owl now launches in the exact aim direction including steep downward angles, widening his execute angles.
indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds bullet velocity 60%→45% cuts his max-range lane poke in the first ten minutes.
Move slow to air-drag ratio 0.35→0.5 taxes him harder whenever he's slowed mid-flight.
Steam Vents losing invisibility removes the free roamer approach the KB flagged as his biggest structural problem — a genuine gain.
Violet's Still Life sketches now give him Spirit Power instead of Weapon Damage, trimming his gun-lane half.
build_changes: Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds faster to recover velocity.
The T2 charge-delay access makes the spirit charge/burst line slightly cheaper to come online.
heroes.one_liner: Vents no longer hand divers a free kill, but his poke still lost bullet speed.

direct_reasons: Spirit per boon 1.1→0.6 nearly halves his spirit scaling, the stat both his builds are built on.
Spirit damage on all abilities reduced 10% (base and growth) compounds the boon cut.
Bullet damage per boon +4% is a partial pivot toward gun, not a replacement for the spirit loss.
indirect_reasons: Torment Pulse melee resistance 18%→22% and Decay heal cut -50%→-55% both buff his core bruiser slots.
Tank/frontline archetype up (Healing Snacks 10%→14%, Heavy Melee Cauldrons) and richer-but-tougher Haunts reward his sustained frontline.
Healbane rework keeps his anti-heal role but trims heal-on-kill 275→170+3/boon, cutting his self-sustain.
build_changes: Shift value toward gun/utility (Quicksilver Reload, Trophy Collector) and away from spirit-stacking damage items.
Torment Pulse and Decay are now stronger relative buys in the same slots.
heroes.one_liner: Still the default front line, but his damage just got a lot smaller.

direct_reasons: Alt fire damage per boon -5% trims his ranged poke.
Serrated Knives rage damage 3.5%→4% current health plus T3 +0.01 spirit scaling strengthens his anti-tank identity.
Killing Blow recast window 16s→12s shortens his execute follow-up.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration is gutted a fourth time (spirit-dmg regen 0.35→0.25, heal-on-cast 65→40, in-combat only) — it is in his near-universal regen core.
The patch's anti-heal stack (Decay 55%, Toxic Bullets 40%, Healbane now stacking) attacks the regen shell he wins extended fights with.
Torment Pulse melee resistance 18%→22% and Decay buff help his bruiser slots.
Tank/frontline archetype up and richer Haunt camps reward his sustain brawling.
build_changes: Move sustain off Radiant Regeneration toward Spirit/Bullet Lifesteal and Leech, which were all buffed.
Keep Torment Pulse and Decay; they gained while his regen layer lost.
heroes.one_liner: Knives hit tanks harder, but the regen shell that kept him alive got gutted.

indirect_reasons: Healing Booster loses its Extra Regen component and +3 flat regen, gutting the cheap upgrade path her heal/anti-heal build sits on.
Anti-heal is the patch's clearest theme (Decay 55%, Toxic Bullets 40%, Healbane stacking), which cuts directly into her tether healing.
Healing Snacks 10%→14% max HP cheapens the dedicated healing she sells.
Her actual primary gun core (Titanic Magazine, Tesla Bullets, Active Reload) is untouched, which caps the damage.
build_changes: Buy Healing Booster standalone rather than as an Extra Regen upgrade, or drop it for buffed lifesteal in the heal build.
heroes.one_liner: Best peel in the game, but every heal item she bought got worse.

direct_reasons: Alchemical Flask travels 40% faster and its weapon-damage reduction rises -25%→-30%, making his poke land and stick.
Willpower speed bonus +15%→+20% improves his walk-up to the silence cage.
Last Stand T2 goes +40.5→+50 DPS and -30s→-40s cooldown, a real mid-game power spike.
indirect_reasons: Steam Vents lose invisibility, restoring Shadow Weave as the only invis-engage tool — the exclusivity the KB said he had lost.
Shadow Weave's rework (+50% ambush weapon damage, applies to the breaking ability) suits his gun-carry ambush more than the old melee/fire-rate version.
Tempo shift toward scaling plus the comeback package (gold cap 30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind) gives his late gun spike room to arrive.
High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60%→45% trims his early poke; Spirit Lifesteal +2 spirit/+2% lifesteal helps his sustain slot.
build_changes: Shadow Weave is back to being a real core in the cage-bruiser line — but plan the 6s stealth buildup before engaging.
Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds faster to offset the velocity cut.
heroes.one_liner: Got his invis-engage back and a real Last Stand spike; still waits on a clock.

direct_reasons: Flying Slash cast range 26m→23m and T3 +15m→+8m shorten her engage and escape reach.
Shadow Transformation cooldown 150s→160s (moved to T2) delays her fight-winning window.
Power Slash spirit scaling +6% is a small damage gain on her primary damage tool.
indirect_reasons: Hunter's Aura now requires line of sight, removing the through-wall shred her late spirit-burst build buys it for.
Torment Pulse melee resistance 18%→22% buffs her late spirit build; Healbane rework is neutral for her.
Haunt bounty +10% and tougher camps reward her punch AoE, still the fastest grouped-camp clear in the game.
Mobile assassin archetype down (vents lose invisibility, tunnels +70%→+50%) trims the roam tempo she lives on.
build_changes: Re-evaluate Hunter's Aura in the late spirit-burst line; it no longer shreds through walls in corridor fights.
heroes.one_liner: Camp clear still elite, but her engage range and ult timer both got shorter.

direct_reasons: Grapple T3 now also grants +4m jump velocity — a small mobility gain on his engage.
Death Slam's cone-to-cylinder indicator is visual only.
indirect_reasons: Steam Vents lose invisibility (now +150% stamina regen), removing the free dive approach the KB credits with extending his routes.
Tunnel move speed +70%→+50% slows the rotations that set up Ground Strike.
The comeback package (gold cap 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) blunts the early snowball an S-tier tempo initiator converts.
Haunt bounty +10% pays camp clearers; Lash has no AoE farm route to take it.
heroes.one_liner: Still the best dive in the game, but the map stopped handing him free entries.

direct_reasons: Splatter T1 +36→+45 damage and alt-fire damage growth +5% per boon lift his primary poke shell.
Goo Ball fixes remove the heavy-melee/Ethereal Shift tech during cast delay — a small loss of outplay.
indirect_reasons: Express Shot secondary fire damage and growth -5% and High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60%→45% both hit his spirit-hybrid Splatter/Punch core.
Decay heal cut -50%→-55% strengthens his anti-heal enabler slot.
Tank/frontline archetype up (Healing Snacks 10%→14%, Heavy Melee Cauldrons) and Steam Vents' stamina regen suit his Cube/Goo Ball sustain.
build_changes: Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds sooner; Express Shot is now a weaker top-end.
heroes.one_liner: Splatter hits a bit harder, his hybrid item shell a bit softer.

indirect_reasons: The comeback package (non-hero gold cap 26%→30%, Haunted Souls up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) restores the bail-out his farm-and-scale line lost — the KB's stated reason he rarely spikes.
Haunt bounty +10% rewards his Monster Rounds/Cultist Sacrifice farm route.
Echo Shard post-cast 0.5s→0.2s speeds reset combos, though usage data shows it near-zero on him.
Mobile assassin archetype down (vents lose invisibility) trims the roamers that dive him.
build_changes: Farming from behind is now a legitimate path back — don't concede the camp route when losing lane.
heroes.one_liner: Finally has a comeback valve for the slow Affliction line.

direct_reasons: Traveler channel 2s→3s and cancel cooldown 4s→5s slow his rotation and escape.
Traveler now breaks on stun/immobilize/sleep/slowing hex, adding real interrupt windows against him.
Base Traveler gains the old T2 barrier (no scaling) and T3 adds 0.8 barrier spirit scaling plus damage-interrupt immunity — a genuine survivability gain.
indirect_reasons: Toxic Bullets anti-heal 35%→40% buffs his spirit-amp hybrid core; Healbane rework is neutral for him.
Split pusher archetype down (breakables growth -10%, tunnels +70%→+50%) trims his map-play income.
The comeback package helps a late scaler, but his problem is income conversion, not catch-up.
build_changes: Treat Traveler as a defensive/barrier tool rather than a free rotation — the 3s channel is punishable.
heroes.one_liner: Tankier Traveler, slower Traveler; the split-push economy still doesn't pay him.
